snippet.title: Last Winter - Point And Click Game
snippet.description:
Last Winter is an original point and click game from indie game developer LYL Games.
The game is completely free and with no ads.
Made with Unity.

Google Play Store
https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.LYLGames.LastWinter

Itch.io
https://lyl-games.itch.io/last-winter

Music: Hopeless by Jimena Contreras
